article: Install the micro text editor on Windows
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared download instructions, Windows environment-variable UI steps, command names, all shortcut keys, metadata, internal links, official references, and both images. Checked release assets and key behavior against official micro project documentation.
findings: Removed the duplicate future publication dates in all editions, preserved the original publication date (2024-03-31), and set lastmod to 2026-11-25.
Updated the download link to the current micro-editor repository and clarified selection of Windows x64 versus ARM64 archives without hard-coding a release version.

Removed the incorrect System Properties click, changed PATH instructions to the current user variable to avoid unnecessary administrator rights, and corrected the verification command from nano to micro.
Corrected Ctrl+Q to explain that it closes the current file and exits micro if it was the last open file; added the official default-keybindings reference.

meaning.note: Compared the complete download, setup, launch, shortcut, image, and reference sections with the Japanese source; fixed the nano/micro mismatch and clarified user-level PATH setup.

terminology.note: Checked micro, Windows x64 and ARM64, Command Prompt, user environment variables, PATH, executable folder, Assets, and shortcut labels.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: Checked sysdm.cpl, the micro command, the archive naming example, and all listed key combinations against the official default key bindings.

links.note: Updated the releases link to the official micro-editor repository; checked official project and keybinding references, the included images, and retained localized internal PATH references.

limitations: AI-assisted review by Codex; no human or native-speaker certification.

Windows ARM devices must select the matching ARM64 archive.
